name: Vytautas the Great
contribution: A ruler of the Grand Duchy of Lithuania, first as regent for his cousin Jogaila and then as the Grand Duke alongside him.
legacy: In 1410, this person himself commanded the forces of the Grand Duchy in the Battle of Grunwald.

checks.lead: Vytautas the Great (; also known as Alexander c. 1350 – 27 October 1430) was a ruler of the Grand Duchy of Lithuania, first as regent for his cousin Jogaila (1392–1401) and then as the Grand Duke alongside him (1401–1430). He was also the prince of Grodno (1370–1382) and the prince of Lutsk (1387–1389), as well as claimant to the titles of King of the Hussites and King of Lithuania.
